title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Greg why are we harassing somebody off the face of the world for making money
What if you’re an unemployed writer or someone fresh out of college looking to break into the industry and you get offered a job at Deadspin
Do you just not take it?
I mean I guess “yes” is an answer
I just feel uncomfortable with that
It’s one thing to not read or support Deadspin. It’s another to crucify people for trying to establish themselves or make money. I dunno. Your tweet was the first thing I just saw
Then I saw other tweets. Poor guy

Hey Anthony, good to hear from ya! How was your trip? Hope you were able to relax a little bit. I’m good, thanks for asking. Mom should be fine, but I’ll wait on test results. Just working and cooking to stay occupied this offseason. Let’s grab dinner or something soon.
Oh no
What’s going on
Why you gotta make me feel like a complete asshole when I’m just ranting
Especially while you’re beating me in fantasy hoops

Because we both know how dumb that guy is posting that shit a day after everyone quit. No better than those people working for the Maven. Someone has to fill in for those writers, but ideally you want to send a message to ownership
Anyway, my mom has to get a biopsy. Should be good my parents indicated but I’ll wait to make sure they aren’t trying to lie to me
OK. When do you find out?
TBD
Ok I’ll say a prayer for a good result. Sorry for the uncertainty
What else is going on
Lol at my transition
Nothing much. Waiting to hear how your story is going.
The ticket office one?
Yeah
I mean, I haven’t done anything on it in nearly a month. My last wave of texts went largely unanswered.
My shop hadn’t given me time to work on it. So I was planning on saying look, I’d like to do this story, give me time to do it ... and see what they say
I don’t think this is a story that you turn around in 2 weeks
And I’m not convinced my bosses want to trade that time from the peanuts of web hits I’ll get doing Tigers shit nobody cares about
This is a story where I probably gotta go knock on Scot Pett’s door and meet with people in person that don’t know me
Or maybe I’m just in too deep with the whole President’s men book I read
The power just went out

Disagree on the shit nobody cares about. I saw your tweet on reddit and tigers mentions. Feel like you might be in a little too deep. As long as you frame it as “illitch family is so cheap they don’t even pay for a staff to sell you the overpriced tickets”
That windy out?
In the Maltese house I’m in
Ohhhhh, shit I thought you were back already?
No and I just changed my flight to stay for 10 more days lol
I went to Serbia for a few days, that was sweet
Well lucky you. I sure as hell would take as many days as I could.
https://twitter.com/alangoldsher/status/1190341197023322113?s=21
This apology was good
That’s fair
I overlooked the timing aspect of it
Is that the story, though
Ilitch is so cheap, or is it the culture
Which has made 32 people leave. My editors wanted something more broad
The culture Ilitch has created?
The culture within the org

Right, I meant it’s kinda both. Which is a cop out answer. Honestly, I dunno, that’s the big question I suppose. Seems like everything starts from the top and funnels down. So if he’s not going to spend money on the team, and he’s not going to spend money on other events like a company softball game or stuff, why would anyone expect to get something that costs money
